meta.name: Research you can cite to the second
meta.description: The research path: a link to one second of the film, the film's own items as W3C Web Annotations, two readers side by side, and a folder of files.
meta.creator: demo

frametrail:attributes.text: <p><span style="font-size: 46px;">Cite a moment, not a file.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px;">Click it. You land at 0:12 of this film.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 34px; color: #ECE9E6;">Every note is a W3C Web Annotation.</span></p>
